text:
*The dust cloud resolves into men — hundreds of them, marching under the red-and-black banners of Baron Varketh. They halt outside bowshot, assessing the barricaded gate.*

*A rider approaches under a white flag. He wears Varketh's colors and carries himself with the arrogance of a man who expects to win.*

Herald: "By order of Baron Varketh, rightful lord of Ashenmoor by treaty and compact, open this gate and submit to lawful authority. Resistance will be met with force."

*The defenders on the wall look to you. Fear is natural — these are shopkeepers and fishermen, not soldiers. But they're here, and they're standing.*

choices.text: Rally the defenders with a rousing speech
Set traps and prepare a tactical defense
Challenge Varketh's herald to single combat — a show of strength
